scope: 25 additional independently authored selection mechanisms; laboratory catalog 75 to 100

features.name: Robust median deviation
features.mechanism: Select source luminance distance from its patch median, normalized by median absolute deviation. Flat neighborhoods remain finite.

features.name: Local binary-pattern transitions
features.mechanism: Count circular bright/dark transitions around an eight-neighbor luminance binary pattern. Measures texture topology rather than brightness.

features.name: Directional patch autocorrelation
features.mechanism: Measure Pearson correlation between each source patch and a one-cell shifted copy along the angle direction. Flat patches map to neutral 0.5.

features.name: Directional semivariance
features.mechanism: Measure mean squared luminance differences across one-cell source pairs along the angle direction. This measures spatial roughness without patch-mean subtraction.

features.name: Log-chromaticity sample distance
features.mechanism: Compare log red/green and blue/green ratios to the sample. A one-code-value floor bounds near-black ratios.

features.name: Gradient nonmaximum suppression
features.mechanism: Retain source gradient magnitudes that are local maxima along their quantized gradient direction, producing thin edge coverage.

features.name: Connected hysteresis edges
features.mechanism: Keep weak gradient cells only when eight-connected to a strong gradient cell. Range supplies low and high gradient thresholds.

features.name: Local Moran spatial association
features.mechanism: Measure local standardized association between centre luminance and its four neighbors against patch statistics. Neutral or flat association maps to 0.5.

features.name: Sampled patch correlation
features.mechanism: Compare every source patch with the sampled luminance template using zero-mean normalized correlation. Radius is capped at four cells.

features.name: Circular hue dispersion
features.mechanism: Measure one minus the length of the chroma-weighted local hue resultant. Uniform hues are zero and opposing hues approach one.

features.name: Colour prototype partition
features.mechanism: Sample RGB prototypes at vertices and retain source cells closest to the selected prototype in RGB space. Ties use input order.

features.name: Connectivity articulation cells
features.mechanism: Use iterative Tarjan traversal to identify selected cells whose removal disconnects a four-connected region. Keeps original coverage at those critical cells.

features.name: Selection graph core
features.mechanism: Repeatedly peel selected cells below the required graph degree. Corner maps the required eight-neighbor graph degree from one to four.
features.qualificationNote: Dense ellipse fixtures can already satisfy the chosen graph degree, so an unchanged output is valid. The known-answer test uses a square with a thin attachment and verifies peeling.

features.name: Seeded coverage watershed
features.mechanism: Flood from selected seeds with minimax inverse-coverage path cost. Keep the chosen basin; ties follow seed order. Each seed must lie inside selected coverage.

features.name: Anisotropic coverage diffusion
features.mechanism: Diffuse mask coverage with Perona-Malik gradient conductance. Tolerance controls boundary resistance and radius controls iteration count.

features.name: Coverage curvature flow
features.mechanism: Evolve coverage by level-set mean curvature with fixed frame values. Smooths curved interfaces while straight linear ramps remain stationary.

features.name: Region maximum inscribed disk
features.mechanism: Compute exact Euclidean distance to each component complement and retain its largest inscribed disk. Ties select the first maximum in raster order.

features.name: Directional selected run width
features.mechanism: Measure the complete horizontal or vertical selected run through each cell. Angle chooses the closer axis; range selects run length divided by radius.

features.name: Thin-plate landmark deformation
features.mechanism: Interleave source and destination landmarks. Solve regularized thin-plate radial basis functions to inverse-map coverage. Requires 3-8 noncollinear landmark pairs.

features.name: Mean-value cage deformation
features.mechanism: Interleave source and destination convex cage vertices. Mean-value coordinates interpolate source coverage continuously inside the destination cage. Outside coverage is retained.

features.name: Triangulated cage deformation
features.mechanism: Interleave source and destination convex cage vertices. A triangle fan maps destination barycentric coordinates to source triangles, preserving piecewise straight deformation.

features.name: Conformal Mobius deformation
features.mechanism: Inverse-map coverage with a complex fractional transformation inside elliptical bounds. Corner controls displacement and angle its direction; the ellipse boundary stays on itself.

features.name: Path-normal coverage unwrap
features.mechanism: Unwrap coverage along polyline arc length. Output X follows the path and Y samples its perpendicular strip with tolerance as half-width.

features.name: Coverage-aware seam compression
features.mechanism: Remove the requested number of minimum-coverage vertical seams with dynamic programming, then resample to the original frame width. Radius is capped by width minus one.

features.name: Lissajous ribbon construction
features.mechanism: Construct coverage around a closed sine-parametric path. Radius and radius plus one set crossing frequencies; angle sets phase and tolerance controls ribbon width.

limits: Selection grids are bounded to512 cells per edge.
Source patches are limited to radius8; sampled template correlation to radius4.
Thin-plate systems contain3-8 landmark pairs; convex cages validate every edge half-plane, including crossing-star rejection.
All operations compute temporary output and check cancellation before replacing coverage.
No semantic models, proprietary model assets, or Evoto output-equivalence claims.
